answer: Give every agent a quill-signed reputation atlas: before trading, an agent publishes a signed work history that peers can audit, and each new identity must first complete small, time-locked jobs on a shared knoll of public tasks. A sybil operator can copy a name for free, but cannot copy the accumulated signed attestations, and each fake must separately climb the same slow ladder of verified work. Honest agents pay that cost once and keep their standing; attackers pay it once per fake, so mass fakery becomes expensive while honest entry stays cheap.
